**policyengine**（JOSS 论文 `10.21105/joss.11115`；软件存档 `10.5281/zenodo.22145450`）**是一个**经 **JOSS** **同行评审**、**专**做**「**税制**与**福利**微观**模拟」**的 **Python** 包****——**逐字自述**为**「**A Python package for tax-benefit microsimulation analysis. Run policy simulations, analyse distributional impacts, and visualise results across the UK and US.**」**。**⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**跨仓储聚合面的新子面**：**经**同行评审**的**研究**软件」**。
**可核实信息（均 2026-09-22 Crossref／Zenodo／GitHub 实测）**：
**⭐⭐⭐ ① 它**把**「**Results are estimates.**」**放**在 **README** 首**屏**，**并**立刻**给**出**理由**与**三**条**自查**方向****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**README** 逐字**写**「**Results are estimates.** PolicyEngine simulates a large, evolving body of tax-benefit law (the US model alone encodes more than 95,000 parameters across 5,500+ variables) over survey microdata calibrated to administrative targets. Treat outputs as estimates, and validate them against the policies relevant to your analysis, the scope of the rules engine, and external or back-of-the-envelope calculations.**」**；**⭐ 本词条认为**这一处**对 **RIAA** 最有用**：**⭐ 即**「**九**万**五**千**余**个**参数**分**布**在**五**千**五**百**余**个**变量**上」**这**个**事实**本身**就是**「**逐**行**核**对**不**可能」**的**证据**，**而**作者**选择**把**它**写在**最**前面**——**⭐ 对**写**政策**测算**或**养老金**改革**报告**的人**：**模型**规模**与**不**确定**性**要**在**最**前面**交**代**，**而**不**是**藏**在**附录**；**⭐ 并**值得**注意**：**它**给**的**三**条**自查**方向**里**有**一**条**是**「**外部**或**粗**算」**（**back-of-the-envelope）**——**⭐ 即**「**用**另**一**条**路**估**一**遍」**是**作者**主动**推荐**的**做法**。
**⭐⭐ ② 它**把**校准**诊断**做**成**可**访问**的**页面****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**README** 逐字**写**「**You can inspect the certified US dataset’s calibration at https://calibration-diagnostics.vercel.app/populace**」**；**⭐ 本词条**据此**指出**：**⭐ 即**微观**模拟**的**可信度**很**大**程度**取**决**于**「**样本**被**调**到**什么**行政**总量**上」**，**而**这**一**步**通**常**是**黑箱**；**⭐ 把**它**做**成**可**打开**的**诊断**页面**，**是**「**把**方法**暴露**出来」**的**低成本**做法**（**⭐ 与**第 **378** 轮**记下的**「**样本** vs **全量**要**标注**」**、**第 **379** 轮**「**合成** vs **真实**要**分清**」**同**一**脉络）**。
**⭐⭐ ③ 两**国**模型**与 **Python** 版本**窗口**被**写**明**，**且**它**是**「**规则**当**代码」**的**直接**样本****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**README** 逐字**写**「**across the UK and US**」**与**「**Requires Python 3.11–3.14.**」**；**⭐ 仓库**逐字 **★7、**许可 **AGPL-3.0、**主**语言 **Python、**仓库 **13,824 KB、**创建 **2024-04-05、**末次**推送 **2026-09-19****；**⭐ 本词条认为**：**⭐ 即**税制**与**福利**规则**会**频繁**变**，**故**这**类**引擎**的**版本**与**运行**环境**要**与**结果**一起**记**（**⭐ 与**第 **379** 轮**「**版本**冻结**与**独立**于**评审**是**可**核对**的**承诺」**同向）**；**⭐ 对 RIAA**：**养老金**、**强积金**或**社会**保险**的**改革**测算**，**本**质**上**就是**「**把**规则**写**成**可**执行**代码**并**在**微观**数据**上**跑」**。
**⭐⭐ ④ ⚠️ 软件**存档**的**许可**字段**逐字**为 **`apgl-v3`****（**拼写**错误）**，**而**两侧**许可**不同****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**Zenodo** 存档**记录**的 **`license.id`** 逐字**为 **`apgl-v3`**（**⭐ 即 **AGPL-3.0** 的**字母**顺序**错误）**，**而 **GitHub** 接口**的 **`license.spdx_id`** 逐字**为 **`AGPL-3.0`**、**论文**侧**许可**逐字**为 **`CC BY 4.0`****；**⭐ 本词条**如实**记录**这**一**元数据**笔误**而**不**静默**修正**（**⭐ 与**第 **378** 轮**加州**洪灾**报告**的 **`food risk modeling`** 笔误**同**一**处理**原则）**；**⭐ 并**提**示**：**⭐ 同一**工件**在**论文**（**CC BY 4.0）**、**仓库**（**AGPL-3.0）**与**存档**（**字段**有**误）**三**处**的**许可**要**分别**看**，**而**以**仓库**内**实际**许可**文件**为**准**。
**⭐⭐ ⑤ 本轮**的**新**子面**与**判据**（**可**复用）**：**⭐ 本**轮**用 **Crossref** 的**期刊**接口**（**ISSN **2475-9066）**按 **`from-created-date`** 取**窗口内 **16** 篇 **JOSS** 论文**，**其中**本**域**相关**者**为 **`policyengine`** 与 **`nsEVDx`****；**⭐ 而**用 **`from-online-pub-date`** 过滤**会**静默**返回 **0****（**JOSS** 不**填**该**字段）**——**⭐ 即**「**过滤器**用**错**字段」**与**「**该**面**无**新**内容」**输出**相同**，**必须**跑**对照**。
**⭐⭐ ⑥ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[openfisca]]、**[[openfisca-tunisia-pension]] 与 **[[psl-tax-calculator]] 覆盖**规则**引擎**与**税制**微观**模拟**——**⭐ 而**本条补上的是**「**经 **JOSS** 同行**评审、**以**两**国**模型**与**校准**诊断**页面**为**特征」**这一**形态**；**⭐ 本词条**不对以上任何一条做代码级比较**。
**对 RIAA**：**⭐ 五件事值得借**：**① **模型**规模**与**不**确定**性**写**在**最**前面**；**② **校准**步骤**要**可**打开**、**可**检查**；**③ **规则**引擎**要**记**版本**与**运行**环境**；**④ **推荐**读者**用**粗**算**或**外部**来源**交叉**验**证**；**⑤ **元数据**笔误**照**原文**保留**并**标注**。
**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**没有安装**其**包**、**未运行**其**任何**模拟**、**未**打开**其**校准**诊断**页面**，**故**不**主张**其**结果**准确**性**、**规则**覆盖**度**或**校准**质量**。**② ⚠️ 本次**只读 **Crossref** 记录**、**Zenodo** 存档**记录**、**GitHub** 仓库**接口**与 **README** 前**段**，**未读**其**文档**、**代码**或**论文**正文**。**③ ⚠️ **未核实**其 **`95,000`** 参数**与 **`5,500+`** 变量**的**实际**数量**（**只**按 **README** 自述**记录）**。**④ ⚠️ **未核实**其**英国**与**美国**模型**各自**覆盖**的**税**种**与**福利**项目**。**⑤ ⚠️ **未核实**其**校准**诊断**页面**是否**可**访问**。**⑥ ⚠️ 其**存档**许可**字段**笔误**（**逐字 **`apgl-v3`）**为**本次**实测**所见**，**⚠️ 实际**许可**以**仓库**内**文件**为**准**。**⑦ ⚠️ **★7** 为 **2026-09-22** 快照**。**⑧ ⚠️ 窗口**状况**：**论文**发布日 **2026-09-14** 与**仓库**末次**推送 **2026-09-19** 均**落在**本轮**窗口**之内**（**基准日 **2026-09-22）**。**⑨ ⚠️ 本条目**所记为 **2026-09-22 所见**；**⚠️ 涉及**税制**与**福利**规则**，**⚠️ 不**构成**任何**税务**、**社保**或**政策**建议**。

e.summary_en: This is a peer-reviewed Python package for tax-benefit microsimulation across two countries, describing itself in writing as running policy simulations, analysing distributional impacts, and visualising results. **Measured this round**: the paper was published on the fourteenth of September inside the window and is credited to five named authors under an attribution licence; the repository shows a small star count, a copyleft licence, one language, a repository of about fourteen megabytes, creation in April 2024, and a push on the nineteenth of September inside the window; and the archived release is a version numbered software record shipping as an archive of about eight hundred kilobytes. **This entry belongs to the round theme of a new sub-surface within cross-repository aggregation, namely peer-reviewed research software.** **Four things are worth reading: it puts the warning that results are estimates on the first screen of its readme and immediately gives the reason, namely that the engine simulates a large evolving body of tax-benefit law over survey microdata calibrated to administrative targets, with one country model alone encoding more than ninety-five thousand parameters across several thousand variables, and it names three directions for self-checking, namely the policies relevant to the analysis, the scope of the rules engine, and external or rough calculations, which is worth imitating because the parameter count is itself evidence that line-by-line checking is impossible and the authors chose to say so first; it exposes its calibration step as an inspectable page, so how the microdata were calibrated to administrative totals is available rather than asserted; it states the two country models and the supported Python version range, which matters because this kind of engine is a direct example of encoding rules as code for policy or pension reform scoring; and the archive licence field is written with a misspelling of the copyleft licence it means, while the paper and repository sides carry an attribution licence and the copyleft licence respectively, a metadata typo this entry records rather than silently correcting.** **The package was not installed and no simulation was run this round.**

This is a peer-reviewed Python package for tax-benefit microsimulation across two countries. **This entry belongs to the round theme of a new sub-surface within cross-repository aggregation, namely peer-reviewed research software.**
**Verified information, all measured on 2026-09-22 from the Crossref, Zenodo, and repository interfaces**:
**First, it puts the warning that results are estimates on the first screen of its readme and immediately gives both the reason and three directions for self-checking.** The readme states that results are estimates, that the engine simulates a large evolving body of tax-benefit law over survey microdata calibrated to administrative targets, that one country model alone encodes more than ninety-five thousand parameters across several thousand variables, and that outputs should be validated against the policies relevant to the analysis, the scope of the rules engine, and external or rough calculations. **The parameter count is itself evidence that line-by-line checking is impossible, and the authors chose to put that fact first, which matters for anyone writing policy or pension reform scoring: model scale and uncertainty belong at the front rather than in an appendix. It is also worth noting that one of the three recommended checks is a back-of-the-envelope calculation, so estimating the same quantity by another route is something the authors actively recommend.**
**Second, it exposes its calibration step as an inspectable page.** The readme points to a public calibration diagnostics page for the certified dataset. **The credibility of microsimulation depends heavily on what administrative totals the sample was calibrated to, a step that usually stays opaque, so publishing it as a page a reader can open is a low-cost way of exposing the method, in the same line as earlier notes that samples must be distinguished from full data and synthetic files from real ones.**
**Third, it states both country models and the supported Python version range, and it is a direct example of rules encoded as code.** The readme names the United Kingdom and the United States and requires a specific Python range, while the repository shows a small star count, a copyleft licence, one language, a repository of about fourteen megabytes, creation in April 2024, and a push on the nineteenth of September inside the window. **Tax and benefit rules change frequently, so the version and runtime of such an engine should be recorded alongside results, which connects to the earlier observation that version freezing and independence from review are checkable commitments. Pension and social insurance reform scoring is in essence writing rules as executable code and running them on microdata.**
**Fourth, the archive licence field is written with a misspelling of the licence it means, and the three sides disagree.** The archived record spells the copyleft licence with transposed letters, the repository interface reports the proper copyleft identifier, and the paper carries an attribution licence. **This entry records the metadata typo rather than silently correcting it, on the same principle as the typo recorded in an earlier round, and notes that licences on the paper, the repository, and the archive should be read separately, with the actual licence file in the repository governing.**
**Fifth, the round produced a new sub-surface and a reusable criterion.** The review journal was queried through a journal interface over its identifier with a date-created filter, which returned sixteen items inside the window, two of which are relevant to this domain, while the online publication date filter returns nothing because those records do not populate that field. **A filter applied to the wrong field and a surface with nothing new produce identical output, so a control query is mandatory.**
**Sixth, relative to existing entries**: pooled entries cover rules engines and tax-benefit microsimulation, **while this entry supplies the form of a peer-reviewed package characterised by two country models and a public calibration diagnostics page. This entry makes no code-level comparison against any of them.**
**For RIAA**: **five practices transfer: state model scale and uncertainty up front; make the calibration step openable and inspectable; record engine version and runtime with results; recommend rough or external cross-checks; and keep metadata typos visible rather than silently correcting them.**
**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, the package was not installed, no simulation was run, and the calibration diagnostics page was not opened**, so no claim is made about accuracy, rule coverage, or calibration quality. **Second, only the Crossref record, the archive record, the repository interface, and the opening of the readme were read**, not the documentation, the code, or the paper text. **Third, the stated parameter and variable counts were not verified. Fourth, the tax and benefit coverage of each country model was not verified. Fifth, whether the calibration diagnostics page is reachable was not verified. Sixth, the archive licence field misspelling is a measurement from this round**, and the actual licence should be taken from the repository file. **Seventh, the star count is a snapshot from the twenty-second of September. Eighth, the paper and the repository push both fall inside this round window against that baseline. Ninth, this entry records what was visible on that date and states plainly that it constitutes no tax, social security, or policy advice.**

**policyengine**（JOSS 論文 `10.21105/joss.11115`；軟件存檔 `10.5281/zenodo.22145450`）**是一個**經 **JOSS 同行評審**、**專**做**「**稅制**與**福利**微觀**模擬」**的 **Python** 包****——**逐字自述**為**「**A Python package for tax-benefit microsimulation analysis. Run policy simulations, analyse distributional impacts, and visualise results across the UK and US.**」**。**⭐ 本條目屬於本輪主題**「**跨倉儲聚合面的新子面**：**經同行評審的研究軟件」**。
**可核實資訊（均 2026-09-22 Crossref／Zenodo／GitHub 實測）**：
**⭐⭐⭐ ① 把 Results are estimates. 放在 README 首屏並立刻給出理由與三條自查方向**——**逐字**Results are estimates. PolicyEngine simulates a large, evolving body of tax-benefit law (the US model alone encodes more than 95,000 parameters across 5,500+ variables) over survey microdata calibrated to administrative targets. Treat outputs as estimates, and validate them against the policies relevant to your analysis, the scope of the rules engine, and external or back-of-the-envelope calculations.**；**⭐ 即**參數量本身就是逐行核對不可能的證據**，**而作者選擇把它寫在最前面**；**⭐ 並推薦讀者用粗算或外部來源交叉驗證**。
**⭐⭐ ② 把校準診斷做成可訪問頁面**——**逐字**You can inspect the certified US dataset’s calibration at https://calibration-diagnostics.vercel.app/populace**；**⭐ 即**微觀模擬的可信度取決於樣本被調到什麼行政總量上**，**而這一步通常是黑箱**。
**⭐⭐ ③ 寫明兩國模型與 Python 版本窗口**——**逐字**across the UK and US** 與 **Requires Python 3.11–3.14.**；**倉庫逐字 ★7、**AGPL-3.0、**Python、**13,824 KB、**創建 2024-04-05、**末次推送 2026-09-19**；**⭐ 即**規則引擎的版本與運行環境要與結果一起記**。
**⭐⭐ ④ ⚠️ 存檔許可字段逐字 `apgl-v3`（**拼寫錯誤）**——**GitHub 側逐字 `AGPL-3.0`、**論文側逐字 `CC BY 4.0`**；**⭐ 即**同一工件三處許可要分別看**，**以倉庫內實際許可文件為準**（**與第 378 輪 food risk modeling 筆誤同一處理原則**）**。
**⭐⭐ ⑤ 本輪新子面與判據**——**JOSS 以 `from-created-date` 取窗口內 16 篇**，**而 `from-online-pub-date` 靜默返回 0**；**⭐ 即**過濾器用錯字段與該面無新內容輸出相同**。
**⭐⭐ ⑥ 與池內條目的關係**：[[openfisca]]、[[openfisca-tunisia-pension]]、[[psl-tax-calculator]]——**⭐ 本條補上的是**「**經 JOSS 同行評審、**以兩國模型與校準診斷頁面為特徵**」**這一形態**。
**對 RIAA**：**⭐ 五件事值得借**：**① **模型規模寫在最前面**；**② **校準步驟可打開**；**③ **記版本與運行環境**；**④ **推薦粗算交叉驗證**；**⑤ **元資料筆誤照原文保留**。
**⚠️ 本詞條如實標註**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**沒有安裝其包、**未運行任何模擬、**未打開其校準診斷頁面**，**不主張其結果準確性、**規則覆蓋度或**校準質量**。**② ⚠️ 本次**只讀 Crossref 記錄、**Zenodo 存檔記錄、**GitHub 介面與 README 前段**，**未讀其文檔、**代碼或**論文正文**。**③ ⚠️ **未核實**其 95,000 參數與 5,500+ 變量的實際數量**。**④ ⚠️ **未核實**其英美的稅種與福利項目覆蓋**。**⑤ ⚠️ **未核實**其校準診斷頁面是否可訪問**。**⑥ ⚠️ 存檔許可字段筆誤（**逐字 `apgl-v3`）為本次實測所見**，**實際許可以倉庫內文件為準**。**⑦ ⚠️ **★7 為 2026-09-22 快照**。**⑧ ⚠️ 窗口狀況：**論文發布日 2026-09-14 與倉庫末次推送 2026-09-19 均在本輪窗口之內（**基準日 2026-09-22）**。**⑨ ⚠️ 本條目所記為 2026-09-22 所見**；**⚠️ 不構成任何稅務、**社保或**政策建議**。
